description: Identifies patients with a positive aldosterone-to-renin ratio screening who may proceed directly to subtype testing without confirmatory testing based on specific clinical criteria. Triggers include spontaneous hypokalemia, baseline plasma aldosterone concentration >100 pg/mL (CLEIA), renin suppression, or a clinician questioning the need for a confirmatory test after a positive screen.
